Raging Bolt

Electric Dragon

Paldea · Generation 9

Raging Bolt is an Electric/Dragon-type Paradox Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 5.2 m tall and weighs 480 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (137), with a base stat total of 590.
